description: This file contains a CMake function GetExternalCode that facilitates fetching external code repositories via git during the build configuration. It includes options for specifying repository URLs, source directories, specific git versions, and force re-cloning. The function performs repository detection, cloning, and checkout operations based on provided arguments.

methods.name: GetExternalCode
methods.description: A CMake function to clone and checkout external repositories (mainly git) during the build configuration, supporting options like repository URL, source directory, specific version, and force re-clone.
